The module declares its schema by calling `defineConfigSchema(moduleName, schema)` at startup. The schema is a plain object whose leaves carry `_type`, `_default`, `_description` and optional `_validators` / `_elements`. Implementers then override those keys through configuration, and the schema defines what counts as valid. I did not trace the override path itself (the config-file or `provideConfig` merge), so that link is described from the docs, not verified in code.

**Documentation**

- The authoritative guide is the external [Configuration System](https://o3-docs.openmrs.org/en-US/docs/configuration-system) page, linked from the JSDoc and the package README. It is not in the Falkon-indexed repos, so I could not read it.
- In-repo API docs: `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-framework/docs/functions/defineConfigSchema.md` (lines 1-34) describes the parameters. `defineExtensionConfigSchema.md` covers the per-extension variant.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-config/README.md` (lines 9-10) points to the same developer docs.

**Implementation**

- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-config/src/module-config/module-config.ts:369-378`: `defineConfigSchema` validates the schema, merges it with the implicit schema, and stores it under the module name.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-config/src/module-config/module-config.ts:445-460`: `defineExtensionConfigSchema` does the same for an extension name, so that extension receives its own config.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-config/src/module-config/module-config.ts:884-929`: `validateConfigSchema` enforces that keys are not reserved ("Display conditions", "Translation overrides"), that each leaf is an object, and that validators are functions.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-config/src/module-config/module-config.ts:1295-1309`: `implicitConfigSchema` is merged into every schema.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-config/src/types.ts:1-22`: the `Type` enum and the recursive `ConfigSchema` interface.

**Examples of real schemas**

- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-primary-navigation-app/src/config-schema.ts:3-56`: a typed schema with `_type`, `_default`, `_description` and `_validators`, plus the matching `ConfigSchema` type.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-api/src/config-schema.ts:5-40`: a framework-level schema with nested keys and an array of numbers.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/index.ts:19-21`: a module calling `defineConfigSchema` from `startupApp()`.

Search and read limits were close to exhausted, so I did not check other repositories beyond core for further overrides or examples.
